en.title: QBittorrent Sandbox Escape Vulnerability Exploited for Criminal Activities
en.hook: A critical sandbox bypass in QBittorrent allows attackers to execute arbitrary code—patch now to protect your system.
key_takeaways: The application’s security sandbox fails to contain malicious processes
Attackers can leverage the flaw to gain full control of infected machines
Users should update immediately to mitigate the risk
